title: Tribal religions and Hinduism
body: India has many tribal communities; in 2011 there were 705 tribes with a population of about 104 million. For long, deities, concepts, legends and rituals have been exchanged between tribal traditions and Hinduism. Some tribes have their own versions of the Mahabharata and the Ramayana, while deities such as Jagannath of Puri are said to have been tribal deities originally. The Indian sociologist Andre Beteille wrote: "The thousands of castes and tribes on the Indian subcontinent have influenced each other in their religious beliefs and practices since the beginning of history and before. That the tribal religions have been influenced by Hinduism is widely accepted, but it is equally true that Hinduism, not only in its formative phase but throughout its evolution, has been influenced by tribal religions."
